author: RAFAEL MELO REIS

provenance.authority: Particle Data Group 2024, Astrophysical Constants and Parameters
Particle Data Group 2024, Neutrinos in Cosmology
provenance.fact: rho_nu/rho_gamma = (7/8) N_eff (4/11)^(4/3); review quotes N_eff=3.044 with a note that recent NLO work may favor 3.043

required_tests: implementation constants equal the preregistered contract
Omega_r*h^2 is invariant across H0 grid
Omega_r is positive and decreases monotonically as H0 increases
RLL Omega_s0=0 recovers LCDM under the derived radiation value at every H0 grid node
both legacy fixed values are represented only as reference-H0 snapshots, not universal physical constants
derived semantics are not labeled full massive-neutrino Boltzmann evolution
promotion_if_pass: omega_r axis may become EVIDENCE_TERMINAL_DERIVED_STANDARD_RADIATION for RX-PHYSICS-CANONICAL-V2 background semantics; legacy fixed values remain named parity projections
boundaries: This is a standard relativistic-radiation background convention, not a full massive-neutrino transition calculation.
Full CLASS/CAMB thermodynamics and perturbations remain downstream gates.
N_eff=3.044 is the repository's versioned reference; the PDG review notes the fourth significant digit remains a precision-theory detail.
No model-fit preference is used to select the radiation convention.
